Class ControllerContributorHome

java.lang.Object
guiContributor.ControllerContributorHome
public class ControllerContributorHome extends Object

Title: ControllerContributorHome Class.

Description: The Java/FX-based Contributor Home Page. This class provides the controller actions basic on the user's use of the JavaFX GUI widgets defined by the View class, including the actions a contributor uses to create, read, update, and delete lessons learned. The class has been written assuming that the View or the Model are the only class methods that can invoke these methods. This is why each has been declared at "protected". Do not change any of these methods to public.

  • Method Details

    • performUpdate

      protected static void performUpdate()

      Method: performUpdate()

      Description: This method directs the user to the User Update Page so the user can change the user account attributes.

    • refreshLessonList

      protected static void refreshLessonList()

      Method: refreshLessonList()

      Description: Reloads the list from the database with only the lessons owned by the logged-in contributor (US-R1). Reading from the database each time, rather than editing the list in memory, guarantees the list always shows what is actually stored.

    • performSelectLesson

      protected static void performSelectLesson()

      Method: performSelectLesson()

      Description: Called when the contributor selects a lesson in the list. The lesson is read again from the database by its ID and its core information is shown in the form (US-R2). If it no longer exists, the not-found message is shown (US-V5).

    • performClearForm

      protected static void performClearForm()

      Method: performClearForm()

      Description: Empties the form and clears the selection, so the contributor can enter a new lesson from a blank form.

    • performAddLesson

      protected static void performAddLesson()

      Method: performAddLesson()

      Description: Opens the dedicated Create Lesson MVC window for the logged-in contributor (US-C1). The Database validates the input with the LessonRecognizer, so the error message shown here is exactly the one the automated tests check.

    • performSaveLesson

      protected static void performSaveLesson()

      Method: performSaveLesson()

      Description: Opens the dedicated Edit Lesson MVC window for the selected lesson (US-U1). If the input is invalid, or the lesson no longer exists or is not owned by this contributor, the stored lesson is unchanged and the reason is shown.

    • performDeleteLesson

      protected static void performDeleteLesson()

      Method: performDeleteLesson()

      Description: Opens the dedicated Delete Lesson window to ask "Are you sure?" (US-D1). Like the Admin delete-user page, the View asks the question and the Database is told the answer, so a "No" answer never changes the database.

    • performLogout

      protected static void performLogout()

      Method: performLogout()

      Description: This method logs out the current user and proceeds to the normal login page where existing users can log in or potential new users with a invitation code can start the process of setting up an account.

    • performQuit

      protected static void performQuit()

      Method: performQuit()

      Description: This method terminates the execution of the program. It leaves the database in a state where the normal login page will be displayed when the application is restarted.
